import 'package:flutter_hazards/label.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

void main() {
  testWidgets('one parcel', (tester) async {
    await tester.pumpWidget(const ParcelLabel(1));
    expect(find.text('1 parcel'), findsOneWidget);
  });

  testWidgets('a few parcels', (tester) async {
    await tester.pumpWidget(const ParcelLabel(9));
    expect(find.text('9 parcels'), findsOneWidget);
  });

  testWidgets('many parcels', (tester) async {
    await tester.pumpWidget(const ParcelLabel(10));
    expect(find.text('many parcels'), findsOneWidget);
  });
}
